tldr: Black Moon Lilith in the 11th house.
body: You refuse to belong to the group on its terms; raw nonconformity in community and friendship. Idealistic and highly selective about friends and groups; risks over-demanding others and feeling betrayed. Wants to make a unique contribution, but needs realism so perfectionism doesn't deliver nothing.
business: A principled voice that won't be absorbed by the crowd.
shadow: Alienation from groups, or burning bridges with allies.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
